---
title: "Why the total energies could be compared"
date: 2026-11-06
description: "While the test suite runs, a question about the DFTK comparison: total energies normally cannot be compared between codes, so why does it work here?"
---

Milestone 2a had just been compared with DFTK, and the two codes agreed on the
total energy of H₂ to about 10⁻¹⁰ Ha. While the test suite and the site render
ran in the background, Mads-Peter asked why that comparison is allowed at all,
since total energies from different codes usually differ by arbitrary offsets.

A single question and answer, included because much of the project has gone
this way: the code and its documents are also the material for learning the
physics.

The comparison itself is in the
[2a validation document](../validation/02a_scf_h2.qmd).
